_what: Ten-Percent Days 3.0 v2 EARLY READ on a historical window the v2 decision never looked at: June-August 2025. Pre-registered 2026-09-15 before the window was scored with v2. It is informational: the forward test (thresholds_lock_v2_forward.json) remains the deciding verdict. Nothing is served on the strength of this read.
why_this_window: The v1 walk-forward window (2025-09..2026-08) is burned: the v2 market-feature fix was chosen by diagnosing its results, so re-scoring it is circular. June-August 2025 precedes that window and was not used to choose v2. Caveat: the research that produced the model design used these months as training data, so this is weaker than forward evidence.
model: v2 (market features over point-in-time universe members), same code and parameters as the forward test

retrain.training_rows: label horizon ends before the first session of the month

baseline: research GBM with the A4 and A5 fixes, walk-forward on the same three months, identical (symbol, target_session) rows
bars: identical to thresholds_lock_v2_forward.json: non_inferior p5 -0.5 pp / AUC -0.003; better +1.0 pp / +0.005 with a week-block bootstrap CI > 0; p_down10_1d ship AUC >= 0.70, PR-AUC >= 1.25x best comparator, p@5 >= 3x base rate, AUC above the best comparator in >= 2 of 3 qualifying months (>= 15 sessions); calibration: mean and top-decile error <= 15%, >= 8 of 10 deciles inside Wilson 95%, log-loss and Brier better than base rate
power_caveat: about 63 sessions = ~315 top-5 slots, p@5 standard error ~2 pp: the 0.5 pp margin cannot be resolved; report the point estimates and the bootstrap interval, do not read a near-tie as a result

regimes.why: three months cannot fill regime cells

failing_head.policy: report only; serving decisions rest with the forward test
